narrative_purpose: The closing image: a sweeping wide view of many floating mountains at sunset, returning to the opening wonder now understood.
subject: A sweeping vista of many floating islands of grey rock, of varying sizes, hanging at different heights across the sky. Each has sheer cliff sides, a flat forested top, and long trailing vines beneath. Some islands are linked by hanging vine bridges. A faint glowing mist in soft curving bands threads between them.
scene: Sunset above a vast cloud sea; the floating archipelago spread across the whole frame into the hazy distance, the lowest islands catching warm light, the higher ones cooler.
camera: Very wide sweeping panorama, high vantage looking out across the field of floating islands.
light: Warm low sunset light from the right gilding the near cliff tops; cool blue shadow and glowing cyan mist in the depths between islands.
palette: Warm amber-gold sunset on the rock tops, deep blue shadowed chasms, blue-green canopies, cyan-teal mist.
style: Painterly photorealistic concept art, epic atmospheric scale.
detail_level: Crisp on the nearest one or two islands; progressively softer atmospheric haze into the distant archipelago.
composition: A near island anchoring one lower corner, the archipelago receding diagonally across the frame to a distant hazy horizon.
consistency_notes: Same grey rock, blue-green canopy, and cyan-teal glowing mist as the cover; this is the warm sunset bookend to the cool dawn cover image.
negative_prompt: no text, no logos, no humans, no machinery, no oversaturation, no cartoon style
